reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the finding correctly proposes no redline and no counterparty comment, which is the expected output for a compliant classification.

The cited text supports the conclusion: IBM (our party, the customer/buyer) may cancel Purchase Orders at any time with no cancellation charge (p0722), may terminate outstanding POs 'without liability for such termination' (p0132), and the express 'penalty' mechanics (p0757 responsiveness penalty) run against MSL, i.e., in our favour and not flaggable per the detection guidance.

The rationale properly addresses the only Customer-payable formulaic amounts (§13.0 f)/Appendix 2 requirements-accuracy compensation at p0903/p1189 and premium-cost reimbursement) and reasonably characterises them as inventory-risk/pricing reimbursement tied to IBM's forecast inaccuracy rather than liquidated damages for breach; this nuance is correctly noted in the rationale rather than raised as a deviation.

No deterministic check failures and no unnecessary edits or over-flagging; nothing in the quoted clauses imposes minimum fees, early-termination fees or penalties on the Customer that would fail the fallback.
